en.title: When an ESTA stops working
en.focal: New passport, new name or new citizenship: apply again
en.alt: Diagram of when an ESTA stops working: it ends after 2 years or when your passport expires, whichever comes first. Everyone needs their own, babies and children too, each on their own passport. A new passport, new name or new citizenship means applying again
en.caption: One clock per traveller, and it never outlives the passport.
